Title: Anil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Anil - 34 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Sanjay - 44 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban
3. Pallavi - 25 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Sunita - 65 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
5. Manoj - 31 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust
2. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne
3. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Anil stands on the battlefield. Sunita, Pallavi and Manoj stand near him.]

Sunita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Anil draws his sword and charges.]

Anil (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Anil salutes the general.]

Sunita: "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The royal court - Day

[Anil is sitting on the throne in the court. Sunita and Pallavi stand near him.]

Anil: "Mother, look over here."

[Anil rises from the throne.]

Anil: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The village well - Day

Sunita: "Anil, look over here."

[Anil draws water from the well with the rope.]

Anil: "Yes, all right."

[Anil drinks water from his cupped hands.]

Anil: "Okay, Pallavi."

[Anil splashes water on his face at the well.]

Anil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
